GAMEPLAY: host-endian route for the big-endian set_hitbox_damage value halfword. The raw u16 cast reads 0x0200 (512) on little-endian hosts for a word whose GameCube value is 0x0002 (2), inflating every article set_hitbox_damage by 256x (observed Fox-laser damage 512.0 tripping the attack-power-over-500 assert). Compose the GameCube u16 explicitly from bytes before masking.
